title: DEV G CRASH ON ANDROID 12
symptom: After compiling the last Dev branch for Asus Zenfone 8 on Android 12, the app crashes on startup after an update, making it impossible to start and no log file is available.
fix: Factory reset the phone and change the POD, which resolved the issue. The user suspects the problem was related to backup or settings.
evidence_quote: I don't know why but it's m'y backup or setting the problem. Factory reset and change POD now work, juste sée if it solve some rebout
